execution_gate: H completion/decision receipt plus all specified C source/model/cache/metric/runtime hashes bound by root before launch
population: Same registered64 of previously exposed calibration internal200

methods.C-U: Frozen QCSI-U of the 792747-candidate C screen
methods.C-8: Frozen QCSI-C8 dictionary and per-source/bin choices of that screen

channel.noise_power: N0=2/10**(average_snr_db/10); per real component variance N0/2

quantizer.observes: source image, average SNR, quantized bin only

frozen_selection_model.conditional_packet_probabilities: C/R/U empirical counts divided by n_blocks; same-h conditional products before integration
frozen_selection_model.quadrature: 32-point Gauss-Legendre on Rayleigh survival probability; split at all curve knots and seven quantizer edges
frozen_selection_model.tails: constant endpoint tails; extreme all-curve tails integrated as exact interval mass times constant value
frozen_selection_model.interpolation: np.interp linear in dB, constant outside endpoints
frozen_selection_model.baseline_selection: Frozen population800 U per-bin maxima over all792747 admitted profiles
frozen_selection_model.dictionary_selection: Frozen winner of exact stepwise greedy max8 vs deduplicated U-bin-winners dictionary; construction800 only
frozen_selection_model.ties: Preserve original code: update_best EPS=1e-14 between candidates/blocks; per-block and per-source np.argmax first exact maximum; dictionaries sorted by catalogue ordinal. Greedy bound EPS=1e-12 is pruning only.
frozen_selection_model.actual_TX_per_source_bin: Use frozen dictionary and same coefficients/Q definition, never observed channel outcome; parity against stored1000x8 choices
frozen_selection_model.sensitivity: Retain old fixed-choice tail/interpolation diagnostics; never use a stress case to reselect the actual policy

receiver.CRC_truth: Protocol acceptance is not known correctness
receiver.rejected_groups: Discard and stop at continuous accepted prefix
receiver.undetected_or_invalid: Preserve actual accepted bits and receiver output; no ground-truth substitution or truth-triggered fallback

qualification.rule: Independent correct-token TX and RX reconstruction; failure requires diagnosis before actual experiment

seeds.serialization: UTF8 json.dumps([namespace,master,source_id,average_snr_db,trial],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":")); SHA256 first16 bytes as unsigned little-endian PCG64 seed
seeds.draw_order: Draw standard_normal(2) for h, then standard_normal((992,2)) for common forward-frame noise
seeds.h: (g0+1j*g1)/sqrt(2), shared by both methods and every header/body group
seeds.noise: sqrt(N0/2)*(z[:,0]+1j*z[:,1]); one common992-complex-symbol array for both methods; slice by physical forward symbol position
seeds.noise_offsets: header[0:68], then each transmitted body group consecutively; unused suffix is not transmitted; paid16pilot+16feedback CSI ideal overhead has no simulated observations

statistics.within_source: average 16 complete trajectories per method/SNR before paired resampling
statistics.interval_label: descriptive source-level paired interval on reused64; not new holdout

online_TX.schedule: For source position i=0..15, use fixed bin i%8 at each4/7/10/13 SNR, both frozen methods;64 source-SNR selections per method
online_TX.framing: Balanced registered bin coverage, not Rayleigh-weighted latency; same source features may only be reused among candidates inside the same frame

main_system_dependency: Complete new1000-calibration final digital policy receipt is still required for final H/main claims; S1 alone is not that baseline.

decision.primary_target: DINOv2-L C8-U paired source interval lower>0 => positive target evidence; crossing0=>UNRESOLVED
decision.noninferiority: For higher-is-better metrics paired interval lower>=0; for LPIPS paired interval upper<=0; any crossing0 is UNRESOLVED
decision.DINO_only: Representation-objective result only, report all costs and stop; do not claim less content error
